name: Color-Minimal Nonshellable Yang Balls
definition: For each $d\ge1$, take the irredundant ample families $X\subseteq Q_d$ whose Yang complex is a nonshellable constructible $(d-1)$-ball, while every link at one literal vertex and every induced deletion of one complete literal pair is shellable. Equivalently, their Alexander-dual full-transversal ideals have a $d$-linear resolution but no linear-quotient order, while all $3d$ one-color restriction and contraction images have linear quotients.
parameters: Dimension $d\ge1$, modulo permutations of the $d$ coordinate colors and independent swaps of the two literals in each color.
canonical_form: An orbit of an ideal $J\in\mathfrak B_d^{\mathrm{col}}$ under $C_2\wr S_d$; the minimal generators uniquely recover the irredundant cube embedding up to that action.
recognition: Check a linear resolution and failure of linear quotients for $J$, then check linear quotients for the two literal-retaining images and the color-contraction image in every coordinate. Equivalently, test nonshellability of the Yang ball and shellability of its $3d$ elementary color minors.
comments: This is an exact predicate parametrization of every ample pc-minimal obstruction to dismantlable ampleness. It is not asserted to be a finite list or a classification by elementary named graph families.
